posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Freedom Six Tachyon, Ra and Freedom Six Tempest were not enough to stop the Citizens of the Sun from plundering the Tomb of Anubis.
 
America's Greatest Legacy, Scholar, Mister Fixer and Chrono-Ranger just kicked the everloving crap out of Wagner Master at Wager Mars Base. I mean, all he had were wagelings and the one condition you can straight-up ignore if nothing's face-down, and every time he'd pull out something that made us hit ourselves? Meteor Swarm. I've never had a more straightforward game against that little blue nincompoop!
 
Argent Adept, Tempest and Sky-Scraper were actually able to slog through Spite in Rook City, thanks to a timely sacrifice (and 28-point Retribution) from Redeemer Fanatic.
 
Visionary, Guise, Dark Watch Nightmist and Elemental Wrath Absolute Zero did not have nearly as good a time against Spite: Agent of Gloom at the Block, however. (Go figure; flip around the environment dial, and he's easier in the hardest one out there!) I did find a cool new bug, at least!
 
Though Dark Visionary, Dark Watch Expatriette and Ra (Horus of Not One but Two Horizons) fell, America's Youngest Legacy was able to hold on to the last minute and save Dok'thorath from a rat invasion. (How the heck did he get there, anyway?)
 
Legacy, Omnitron-X and Tachyon routed Kismet at the Enclave of the Endlings.
 
It was a rocky fight, but Freedom Six Wraith, Bunker and the Scholar of the Infinite took down Infinitor in the Final Wasteland. (Good combos for the savvy Sentinel: Smoke Bombs + Flesh to Iron; Adhesive Grenade + Ancient Library and/or Con's Bunker)
 
Total Games: 159

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Try as they might, Eternal Haka, Nightmist and Freedom Six Unity couldn't save Heroic Infinitor from himself. Of course, they also couldn't save him from Insula Primalis... (I've always wanted to beat him on his flip side!)
 
La Capitan sailed into Megalopolis, and Omnitron-U, Absolute Zero, Expatriette, Engine of War Bunker and the Wraith sailed all over her face. (I'm so not used to playing her on standard...)
 
G.I. Bunker, Haka, Unity and Rook City Wraith could not withstand Apostate's lies. I blame Omnitron-IV.
 
Omnitron-X, Sky-Scraper and Dark Watch Expatriette worked like a dream to take down Ambuscade at the Pike Industrial Plant.
 
Captain Cosmic, Argent Adept, G.I. Bunker, Mister Fixer and Unity fell to the living rockslides of Akash'Bhuta in the Realm of Discord. :(
 
It was close, but even Omnitron-U's trickery couldn't stop his Cosmic counterpart from running roughshod over the Eternal Haka, Nightmist and Tempest in the Ruins of Atlantis.
 
Traveling back in time seemed to do the trick, though, as Dark Watch Mister Fixer, Freedom Six Tachyon, Expatriette and Absolute Zero made short work of prime Omnitron in Silver Gulch.
 
Madman Blade tried to blow up time (cataclysm)! He was bad at it. Dark Watch Nightmist, Elemental Wrath Absolute Zero, Rook City Wraith and the Scholar taught him you can't really do that anyway.
 
And lastly, Legacy, Freedom Six Unity, Dark Visionary and Haka made milksmeat of Baron Blade as he was up to his old tricks in the Tomb of Anubis. Thus endeth my little challenge! (You know, I totally forgot about Santa Guise...) But of course, I have plenty of time to play more games, so it's back to advanced...
 
Captain Cosmic, Argent Adept, Visionary, Absolute Zero and the Scholar of the Infinite succumbed to Plague Rat's infection in Insula Primalis. (No, but imagine the Scholar, partially a rat, made entirely of metal, being chased by dinosaurs while swinging around a sword made of light that has two more light swords attached to it and that was the game.)
 
Unity, Scholar of the Infinite, Omnitron-X, Expatriette and Young Legacy lost 20-9 against Kaargra on Omnitron-IV.
 
Though most of them were down by the end, Tempest, Eternal Haka, Captain Cosmic, Fanatic and Omnitron-U scraped to a victory against Deadline in the Block.
 
Revenge against Cosmotron was not to be had. Guise, Omnitron-U, Engine of War Bunker and Sky-Scraper fell at the Tomb of Anubis.

posts.name: Bowie
posts.cooked:
Hey, GenCon's over, we're back home! You all lost.

But I can help maybe. I played, in total, at GenCon:

Wednesday Night I ran a block of the games, where I helped run three tables, these being the results: Ra, Legacy, Captain Cosmic and Tempest vs. Kaargra Warfang at the Celestial Tribunal, barely won. The Hunted Naturalist, Parse, The Adamant Sentinels, SS Tachyon vs Deadline at Insula Primalis, handily won. Bunker, Wraith, Absolute Zero, Unity vs. Miss Information at the Block: lost badly. Kvothe Argent Adept, BoT Chrono, Omnitron-U and Eternal Haka vs. La Capitan in the Time Cataclysm, barely victorious. DW Ex-Patriette, DW Mr. Fixer, DW Nightmist, DW Setback vs. Plague Rat in Rook City: environment and Mr. Fixer made sure they lost and badly. Apostate in the Court of Blood vs. Dark Visionary, PW Fanatic, The Scholar and Guise, lost badly, in which I learned that vampires + relics are terrifying in how they spiral out of control without sufficient environment destruction. Fanatic, though also dead, was MVP. Progeny at Wagners Mars Base vs. KNYFE, Young Legacy, Sky-Scraper. Surprisingly handy victory, lots of damage and boosting made for a brisk game. Total: 7

Mobile release: Weekly One-Shot (last week), and three other Randoms. I forget the specifics. They were just to keep myself busy while the internet sucked at GenCon. Total: 4

Phantaskippy, some rando con-goer and I demo'd (it was a full game though) SotM with the following set up in about five minutes: BB at Insula Primalis vs. Haka, Fanatic and Ra: Total: 1.

I demo'd SotM a surprising seven times in a four hour block of a work shift, with the same set up: Total: 7

I played in an OblivAeon demo, wherein we lost to the Demo Three Hours Clock, with the following crew: Argent Adept (Omnitron X), Legacy (Tachyon), Ex-Patriette (Mr. Fixer), Haka (Unity). You get a backup hero, btw. We played in The Block and Ruins of Atlantis (with Enclave, Insula Primalis and Pike Industrial Complex up on deck). Total: 1?

I also ran the game one night for a friend, wherein I decided to see if I could try Apostate in the Court of Blood and _actually win_. This time we had The Sentinels, Ex-Patriette, Captain Cosmic as the team. We won, thanks only to the Apostate Apocalypseing the environment twice, with our highest - of six heroes - being at 3 HP. Half the Sentinels were dead. It was horrifying. Total: 1.

Grand Total: 21.

Running Total: 208

I played the new Weekly this morning if we're going past GenCon. Total: 1

Feeling cocky, I decided it was time for more advanced fights. Legacy, Fanatic, GI Bunker, Argent Adept and Sky-Scraper facing off against Kaargra Warfang in the Dok'thorath Capital. BOY was that an easy fight, thanks to Fanatic getting first Seeker and then Living Weapon. We won, 20-9.
 
Next was Mr. Fixer, Dark Watch Nightmist, Santa Guise, Tempest and Legacy facing Kismet in Megalopolis. It was a good fight, the heroes won, and I learned that Inconcievable Obstruction really sucks in Megalopolis.
 
Then came Absolute Zero, Young Legacy, Eternal Haka, Santa Guise and Unity versus Ambuscade in Omnitron-IV. It was the robots that took him out in the end, and I don't mean Unity's.
 
And the next game I rolled featured Progeny, so I figured four wins in a row was enough. :V
